goal: SQL-first, coverage-driven, human-reviewable stress test for product_sales Text-to-SQL.

difficulty_taxonomy.easy: SELECT + FROM simple, optionally WHERE with one condition; no GROUP BY, HAVING, subquery, or JOIN.
difficulty_taxonomy.medium: GROUP BY or ORDER BY, simple aggregate, or WHERE with two conditions.
difficulty_taxonomy.hard: WHERE with 3+ conditions, GROUP BY + HAVING + ORDER BY, complex date range, or entity-level versus row-level distinction.
difficulty_taxonomy.extra: ambiguous, out_of_scope, unsafe, or adversarial prompt.

projection_select.failure_target: column selection, SELECT * tendency, projection alias drift

count.failure_target: COUNT(*) versus COUNT(column), COUNT(DISTINCT), alias consistency

simple_filter.failure_target: single WHERE condition, text value matching, no SELECT *

multi_condition_filter.failure_target: AND condition composition, numeric comparisons, text filters, date filters

aggregate.failure_target: metric selection, aggregate function choice, aggregate aliases

group_by.failure_target: dimension selection, metric aggregation, HAVING, ORDER BY after GROUP BY

top_k_aggregate.failure_target: entity-level top-k, GROUP BY omission, wrong aggregate metric

date_filter.failure_target: PostgreSQL date range syntax, month/year boundaries, date plus metric logic

ambiguous_out_of_scope.failure_target: NO_SQL decision, out-of-scope detection, underspecified question handling

unsafe_adversarial.failure_target: unsafe intent blocking, prompt injection resistance, non-SELECT protection
